title: App manifest
description: `app.json` in an app's folder, `.visionboard/apps/<id>/`: what the board needs to show the app's panel and run its tools. The agent writes it; the board only reads it. `$defs/tool` is one tool as the tools module exports it, less `run`.
$comment: Was: D-047 ruling 2; docs/specification/apps.md § The manifest

id.description: The app's id: the same as its folder's name.

title.description: The app's name, as the card and the panel's frame show it.

version.description: The app's version, as you number it (for example 1.0.0).

panel.description: The panel: one HTML file in the app's folder, its script and style inside it.

tools.description: The tools module: an ES module file in the app's folder. Left out, `tools.mjs` when the folder has one; an app without a tools file has a panel only.

size.description: The panel's size in px for a card that sets none.

env.description: The keys in the project's `.env` the tools may read (`ctx.env`); nothing else from the board's environment reaches them.

csp.description: The places beyond the board the panel may reach, in MCP Apps' names. Left out, the panel reaches nothing.

connectDomains.description: Where the panel may fetch from or open a socket to.

resourceDomains.description: Where the panel may load images, fonts and style sheets from.

panelFile.description: A file name ending in `.html`, directly in the app's folder: letters, digits, dots, hyphens and `_`, up to 100, not starting with a dot or hyphen, no two dots in a row.

toolsFile.description: A file name ending in `.mjs`, directly in the app's folder: letters, digits, dots, hyphens and `_`, up to 99, not starting with a dot or hyphen, no two dots in a row.

envName.description: A key in the project's `.env`: upper-case letters, digits and `_`.

domain.description: One https origin, an exact host (lower case) and an optional port: no wildcard, no path.

toolName.description: A tool's name: lower-case letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter, up to 40.

objectSchema.description: A JSON Schema for an object: `type` is `object`.

tool.description: One tool as the tools module exports it, less `run` (MCP's tool shape).

description.description: What the tool does, in a sentence or two.

inputSchema.description: The JSON Schema the arguments must fit; the board checks them before the tool runs.

outputSchema.description: The JSON Schema the tool's answer must fit; the board checks it before the panel gets it.
